content_of_post_to_comment: I'm gonna be real with you all. I don't know how to talk to God. It feels weird. It's feels awkward. It feels like I'm talking to thin air. It feels like he isn't real. I personally don't how to come before Him with my pain and struggles. I feel shame for even speaking this out loud. Please just simply be a WITNESS to my pain and struggles. Please sit down next to me in the dirt. Please do NOT provide me with solutions, Bible verses, what's worked for you, encouragement or the like. I'm truly NOT trying to change or fix where God has me. I'm simply trying to be with what He's trying to change in me. I'm NOT asking for anyone to understand my boundaries. But I am simply asking you to respect them.
comment: There’s a subtle difference between wanting an answer from God and wanting the space to be honest before God. Maybe faith sometimes begins not with certainty, but with the courage to stop performing certainty.
